summary: Wipro Limited filed a Form 6-K announcing a share buyback offer for up to 600 million equity shares (face value ₹2 each) at ₹250 per share via tender offer through stock exchange mechanism. The buyback was approved by the board on April 16, 2026, and requires shareholder approval via special resolution. This is an issuer tender offer / capital return to shareholders. The filing includes a public announcement, press release, and notice to ADS holders. It is subject to Indian SEBI regulations. Watch for shareholder vote and execution timeline; no break fee or premium stated.
